entities.name: Rushwood
entities.description: A large living forest southwest of Mercadia City, home to the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: The city to the northeast of Rushwood.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: A spiritual people living under the care of the forest, rebels against the magistrate's rule.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Brought to Rushwood by the Cho-Arrim in 4205 AR, where she stayed a month learning their culture.

entities.name: Drianan
entities.description: Wounded man brought to Rushwood who died of his injuries.

entities.name: Klaars
entities.description: Wounded man brought to Rushwood who died of his injuries.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship that brought Orim to Rushwood.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Led Mercadian soldiers in attacking the Cho-Arrim village, then ordered hostilities to stop.

entities.name: Is-Shada
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim killed in the attack.

entities.name: Is-Meisha
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim killed in the attack.

entities.name: Ta-Spon
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim killed in the attack.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim assumed killed who survived unseen.

events.summary: In 4205 AR the Cho-Arrim bring Orim aboard the Weatherlight to Rushwood alongside the wounded Drianan and Klaars, who both die.
events.quote: Orim was brought to the Rushwood aboard the Skyship Weatherlight by the Cho-Arrim

events.summary: Mercadian soldiers led by Gerrard Capashen attack the Cho-Arrim village, slaughtering most of its inhabitants.
events.quote: a contingent of Mercadian soldiers led by Gerrard Capashen attacked the village, slaughtering most of its inhabitants

events.summary: Realizing he is on the wrong side, Gerrard orders hostilities to stop and kills his own troops.
events.quote: When Gerrard realized he was working for the wrong side, he ordered hostilities to stop

events.summary: Gerrard, Orim and the Weatherlight crew are arrested and brought to Mercadia City.

relations.note: They live under the forest's care.
relations.quote: The Cho-Arrim , a spiritual and mystical people, live under the care and protection of the forest itself
